This template is to be used for citing individual pages on [[Yen Press]]'s [https://yenpress.com/ official website].

==Usage==
Copy the template code below and paste it into the appropriate place in an article, fill the required fields, and remove any that you don't use.

<code><nowiki>{{YenPress|url=|text=|archivedate=|archiveurl=|nobackup=}}</nowiki></code>

All fields need to be explicitly assigned to; otherwise, use of the "=" symbol in the URLs messes up the template.

===Required parameters===
*'''url''': URL of the web page, minus the domain name (<code><nowiki>https://yenpress.com/</nowiki></code>).
*'''text''': Name of the page being cited.
*For '''archive''' options, see [[#Backup links|Backup links]] below.

===Optional parameters===
*{{Para|nolive}} When the original online content is no longer available, add "<code>|nolive=1</code>".

===Backup links===
{{BackupLinkHelp}}

==Example(s)==
<code><nowiki>{{YenPress|url=titles/claudia-gray/star-wars-lost-stars-vol-1-manga/9781975326531/?yen|text=Star Wars Lost Stars, Vol. 1 (manga)}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{YenPress|url=titles/claudia-gray/star-wars-lost-stars-vol-1-manga/9781975326531/?yen|text=Star Wars Lost Stars, Vol. 1 (manga)}}

<hr />
<code><nowiki>{{YenPress|url=titles/claudia-gray/star-wars-lost-stars-vol-1-manga/9781975326531/?yen|text=Star Wars Lost Stars, Vol. 1 (manga)|nobackup=1}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{YenPress|url=titles/claudia-gray/star-wars-lost-stars-vol-1-manga/9781975326531/?yen|text=Star Wars Lost Stars, Vol. 1 (manga)|nobackup=1}}
